problem:
If $A={a,b}$ and $B={1,2},$ which of the following elements belong to $A\times A\times B?$

- $(a,a,1)$
- $(b,a,2)$
- $((a,b),2)$

feedback.problem:
If $A={p,q}$ and $B={2,4,6},$ which of the following elements belong to $A\times A\times B?$

- $(p,q,2)$
- $((p,p),4)$
- $(q,q,6)$
feedback.worked_solution:
The Cartesian product $A\times B\times C$ consists of all ordered triples whose first coordinate belongs to $A,$ second coordinate belongs to $B,$ and the third coordinate belongs to $C.$

In this case, $A\times A\times B$ consists of every combination of ${p,q}$ with ${p,q}$ and ${2,4,6},$ which results in

$$
\begin{aligned}A\times A\times B={ & (p,p,2),(p,p,4),(p,p,6),(p,q,2),(p,q,4),(p,q,6), \\  & (q,p,2),(q,p,4),(q,p,6),(q,q,2),(q,q,4),(q,q,6)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Note that

$$
|A\times A\times B|=|A|\cdot |A|\cdot |B|=2\cdot 2\cdot 3=12.
$$

From the given options, we see that both $(p,q,2)$ and $(q,q,6)$ are in $A\times A\times B.$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I and III only."
